registration.statement: The admitted proton/electron algebraic graph receives the complete electromagnetic self-coupling of its three-depth colour composite.  Binary-by-colour-cubed support has heavy complement 53; the complete colour bulk and its three carried boundary channels supply support 27+3=30; both charged Fold ends force alpha squared; and the sole terminal return transports the two Fold labels through down-depth five and colour volume 27 once.  The retained ratio is therefore the admitted algebraic ratio times One held by 53 alpha^2/30 times (One plus 2 alpha/135).
